name: Scavengers Reign
description: When a deep space freighter is damaged by a solar flare its surviving crew are stranded on a beautiful and unforgiving planet. They begin to learn the true nature of this planet as they try to survive long enough to escape or be rescued.

videos.title: The Signal
videos.overview: After their deep-space freighter is damaged, the stranded crew of the Demeter must fight to survive on a beautiful yet dangerous planet.

videos.title: The Storm
videos.overview: As a storm rages, Sam and Ursula set out to find the Demeter, while Azi and Levi seek shelter. Meanwhile, Hollow helps Kamen revisit old memories.

videos.title: The Wall
videos.overview: While Ursula bears witness to a transformation, Azi struggles with Levi's ever-changing personality as she tries to survive a deadly stampede.

videos.title: The Dream
videos.overview: Alone and in pursuit of Sam, Ursula resorts to desperate measures, while Kamen continues his hunt amid Hollow's demands.

videos.title: The Demeter
videos.overview: After an encounter with another survivor, Kamen considers the weight of his actions, while Azi experiences a change of heart.

videos.title: The Fall
videos.overview: While Ursula faces an all-too familiar adversary, Azi and Levi find themselves pitted against a formidable new foe.

videos.title: The Cure
videos.overview: Facing mounting health issues, Ursula and Azi each find that they are not alone.

videos.title: The Nest
videos.overview: While Azi leads Kris, Terrence, and Barry towards her downed ship, Ursula struggles to keep up with an overzealous Sam.

videos.title: The Mountain
videos.overview: After reaching an insurmountable obstacle, Azi must learn to trust Kris and Barry. Meanwhile, rough waters test a newly reborn Sam.

videos.title: The Decision
videos.overview: In range of the wrecked Demeter, Azi confronts Kris about the ship's remaining survivors, while Sam delivers a devastating truth.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: As Ursula races to reach the ship, Azi fights to get free and Kamen faces a haunting new vision. Onboard the Demeter, Kris finally meets her match.

videos.title: The Reunion
videos.overview: In a bid to save the surviving crew, Azi and Ursula face-off against their greatest threat yet, while a conflicted Barry weighs an important decision.

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 1 win & 5 nominations total
